THOO-M1.description: Time History Output Option (THOO-M1). A single-instance (key always 1) model-wide setting; OUT_OPT drives the inelastic hinge / fiber step-by-step output options and RESULT_SELECTION toggles which device results are stored.

OUT_OPT.description: Nonlinear Analysis Result Output Option. Controls inelastic hinge and fiber-section step-by-step result output.

HINGE_OUT.description: Inelastic Hinge Output Option: 0 = All Inelastic Elements, 1 = Selected Elements in Hinge Result Output, 2 = No Step-by-Step Results.

COMMON_OPT.description: Common with Inelastic Results option. When true, FIBER_OUT is ignored and forced equal to HINGE_OUT. When false, FIBER_OUT must be supplied and must be >= HINGE_OUT.

FIBER_OUT.description: [COMMON_OPT=false] Fiber Section Output Option: 0 = All Inelastic Elements, 1 = Selected Elements in Hinge Result Output, 2 = No Step-by-Step Results. Required when COMMON_OPT is false; hard constraint FIBER_OUT >= HINGE_OUT. Ignored (set equal to HINGE_OUT) when COMMON_OPT is true.

RESULT_SELECTION.description: Result Selection. Toggles which time-history device/energy results are stored.
